author: tbolt
description: A lean, local-first garden planner. Lay out beds on a grid, plan spacing for each plant, build a planting calendar from your frost dates, track tasks, and log every harvest. Data lives on your NAS.
tagline: Plan the rows before you dig them

tips.before_install:
## Furrow

Data (beds, plant library, My Garden, frost dates, tasks, harvest log) is stored on your ZimaOS disk at `/DATA/AppData/furrow/`, so it survives container rebuilds and is shared across every browser on your network.

title: Furrow
release_note:
- Revamped plant library: grouped, searchable list with detail cards.
- Add, edit, and delete your own plants; richer grow metadata (spacing, start indoors, sow-after-frost, tender).
- Tighter My Garden integration with per-plant add/remove.
